Bending Hypotenuse

FACT CHECK

Mystery Debunked

Quick answers to common questions:

01

Is it a real triangle?

No. It is a 4-sided quadrilateral with a slight 1.24° kink along the hypotenuse.

02

Why does it look straight?

Human vision. The 0.077-unit bend is smoothed over 13 units by our visual perception.

03

Who created it?

Paul Curry (1953). Created by amateur magician Paul Curry, popularized by Martin Gardner.

04

Does it work in physical wood?

Yes. Physical saw cuts and wood grain easily conceal the imperceptible bend.
